methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: This work starts with the application of the classical statistical approach and then proceeds to compare two different machine learning techniques, artificial neural networks and support vector machines, for the creation of energy performance indicators.

paper_type.evidence_quote: making use of the results of a real application to a compressed air generation unit in a production plant.

level_3b.evidence_quote: The comparative analysis has been applied to the case study of a compressed air generation system in an Italian manufacturing company.

stage1.notes: The case is framed only as a manufacturing company; no closed-list continuous-process sector is explicitly identified.

multi_site.evidence_quote: The comparative analysis has been applied to the case study of a compressed air generation system in an Italian manufacturing company.

evidence_quote: The inputs of the three regression models are global flow rate, ratio flow rate and external air temperature. The output of all models is the global energy consumption (sum of the single values of energy consumption for all the compressors).
Three different typologies of models have been therefore realized: artificial neural network, support vector machine and statistical linear regression.

the comparison includes a graphical inspection of the resulting residuals control charts produced, showing the difference between the actual value of energy consumption and the one predicted by the model
